# Does the vendor rate actually save you money?

> Free supplier, subcontractor, and equipment rate break-even calculator. Compare fixed fees, per-job costs, savings, and payback volume.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
